panelSpecification.concreteGenerationSpecification: Restage as a candid calculation at the lab workbench. Remove the outward held paper entirely. Farah and Demir sit at two adjacent sides of a small desk, body and chair angles naturally directed toward a sloping calculation pad lying between them. Camera looks diagonally from beside the pad, showing natural three-quarter faces and surface perspective. Demir has just circled MSE0 with his stylus; his brows rise and his mouth parts in surprise as he looks toward Farah. His free hand rests on the desk. Farah watches him with a precise skeptical raised eyebrow, one index finger resting next to the distant input and the other hand on her notebook. Four anatomically continuous arm chains, realistic hands and grips. Pad headed Constructed mapping has two exact rows: [1000,0] rebuilt [1000,0], MSE0; [0,0.2] rebuilt [0,0], MSE0.02. Small note: Low error can miss an anomaly. Keep lettering scaled and aligned to the pad perspective, not front-facing flat text. All wall screens off; no lecture heading behind them. Natural warm lamp light, lab pillar dark muted sage, aged brass, charcoal and no neon.
